gen-dafont-zag-fs-asap: Commanding, tight-tracked Zag firmly sets the tone with oversized-looking small letters. Asap supplies the readable sans text, its lowercase rising almost to capital height and its curves staying open.
gen-dafont-zag-fs-epilogue: Zag comes in tight and bold, its wide-mouthed letters staying crisp when shrunk, the small letters looking oversized. Epilogue's wire-like monoline curves, approachable and tall-bodied, echo that shared build closely.
gen-dafont-zag-general-sans: Tight tracking and oversized small letters make Zag unmistakable from the first word. General Sans, built much like Zag, draws smooth, unobstructed curves with steady pressure and an x-height that fills the line.
gen-eater-fs-rowan: Rowan brings literary friendliness, its generous curve openings and thin strokes at half the weight of thick ones. Eater looms above, dark and wide-spaced, its short ascenders keeping things compact.
gen-eater-gf-almendra: Eater is dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between its letters. Almendra, a dignified text serif whose lowercase has a deep midsection, brings bookish gravity to the lines beneath it.
gen-eater-gf-bree-serif: Eater snarls in dark, hairline-free strokes, its wide letter gaps and short ascenders giving display menace. Bree Serif does the opposite job, a refined text serif whose outsized lowercase carries the reading.
gen-eater-gf-port-lligat-slab: Port Lligat Slab reads literary and traditional, its lowercase counters wide as glass portholes and its curves open-ended. Eater, meanwhile, handles the dark, aggressive shouting, while the serif handles the quieter talking.
gen-eater-gf-quando: Hairline-free thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems give Eater its dark bite. Quando, a bookish text serif, brings sparse, wide spacing and a big, tall middle zone to every word.
gen-flavors-gf-almendra: Almendra is a dignified, bookish serif whose lowercase carries a deep midsection through each line. But Flavors takes the whimsical, commanding role up top, its towering x-height looking pencil-drawn.
gen-flavors-gf-bree-serif: Whimsical Flavors towers up top, its uppercase built from lines of one constant thickness. And Bree Serif's outsized lowercase gives the refined text serif a presence that holds its own.
